title: Photograph viewing study
shortDescription: This session takes about 15–20 minutes. Please read the overview below, then review the consent text.
procedureSteps: You will skim a set of 15 photographs—you have about one minute to view all of them.
You will then complete a short Pac-Man-style game (about two minutes)—please focus on the game only during that break.
You will skim 15 images again (a modified version of the set) for about one minute.
After that, you will complete a short set of items about the first group of images you viewed.
For research reasons we cannot disclose every detail of the study’s purpose in advance, but nothing in this task is expected to cause you harm.
consentText: This research is for academic purposes and your responses will be handled anonymously. Participation is voluntary and you may stop at any time. If you agree, you may begin below.
baselinePhaseInstructions: The following images are similar to everyday, news, or documentary-style scenes. Browse each scene naturally. Swipe the screen or use the buttons to move between images. You have about one minute on this screen; when that time runs out, the study advances to the next step automatically—you cannot stay longer or pause this block.
conditionPhaseInstructions: The following images are modified versions of the first image set—the same scenes, reworked for this second pass. Browse each scene naturally. Swipe the screen or use the buttons to move between images. You have about one minute on this screen; when that time runs out, the study advances to the next step automatically—you cannot stay longer or pause this block.
memoryPhaseInstructions: Each line below goes with a corresponding image from the first viewing block. For each item, choose Agree / Disagree / Not sure, then rate how confident you are on a scale of 1–7.

conditionLabels.no_edit: No edit (same static image as original)
